# Indikator 4b

**Indikator 4b** is a clinical quality indicator within the [[databasen-for-atrieflimren-i-danmark|Databasen for Atrieflimren i Danmark]] (AFDK) that measures the safety and monitoring of anticoagulation therapy [^src1]. Specifically, it tracks the proportion of prevalent patients diagnosed with [[atrieflimren]] who are treated with [[doac|direct oral anticoagulants (DOAC)]] and receive at least one annual kidney function test, measured via [[p-creatinin|P-creatinin]] or [[s-creatinin|S-creatinin]] [^src3]. Because DOAC dosing must be adjusted based on renal function to ensure patient safety, the national standard for this indicator is set at ≥95% [^src5]. 

The indicator relies on a robust national data infrastructure. The prevalent patient population is identified using the [[landspatientregisteret|Landspatientregisteret]], DOAC prescriptions are tracked via the [[laegemiddelstatistikregisteret|Lægemiddelstatistikregisteret]], and the actual laboratory measurements are sourced from the [[laboratorieregistret|Laboratorieregistret]] [^src2]. Unlike many hospital-centric metrics, Indikator 4b is calculated at the municipality level rather than the hospital level, reflecting the fact that atrial fibrillation is predominantly managed in general practice long after the initial diagnosis [^src2]. The indicator is governed by the [[afdk-styregruppe|Styregruppen for AFDK]], which has actively recommended greater focus on this metric, including advising hospitals to explicitly mention the need for kidney function checks in discharge summaries when patients are prescribed DOACs [^src2].

Despite its clinical importance, national performance has consistently fallen just short of the target. During the 2022–2023 reporting period, 94% of the prevalent DOAC-treated population received their annual creatinine measurement, failing the ≥95% standard [^src2]. In the subsequent 2023–2024 period, national fulfillment was 93.9%, representing a slight increase of 1.1 percentage points over three years but still missing the national target [^src4]. 

Geographically, there is distinct regional variation. [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] has been the only region to consistently meet the standard, achieving 95% in 2022–2023 and 95.7% in 2023–2024 [^src2]. Other regions, including [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]], [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]], [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]], and [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]], have generally scored between 92% and 94% [^src2]. At the more localized cluster level, only specific areas such as [[midtklyngen|Midtklyngen]] and [[sundhedsklynge-lillebaelt|Sundhedsklynge Lillebælt]] have met the standard alongside the clusters in Nordjylland, while no clusters in the eastern regions of [[danmark|Danmark]] have succeeded [^src4].

## Timeline

- 2022-07-01: Start af rapportperioden for Indikator 4b og Indikator 5 (indikator-4b, indikator-5) [^src2]
- 2023-06-30: Afslutning af rapportperioden for Indikator 4b og Indikator 5 (indikator-4b, indikator-5) [^src2]
- 2022-07-01: Definition af den prævalente population for Indikator 4b: Alle personer, som var i live pr. 1. juli 2022, og som havde fået diagnosen registreret i Landspatientregisteret mindst én gang inden for de foregående 10 år (indikator-4b, landspatientregisteret) [^src2]
- 2023-07-01: Start af dataindsamlingsperiode for Indikator 1, Indikator 2, Indikator 3 og Indikator 4b (indikator-1, indikator-2, indikator-3, indikator-4b) [^src4]
- 01.07.2023 - 30.06.2024: Aktuel måleperiode for Indikator 4b på nationalt og regionalt niveau (indikator-4b) [^src5]
- 2023-07-01: Start af opgørelsesperioden for indikator 4b og indikator 5 (01.07.2023 - 30.06.2024) (indikator-4b, indikator-5) [^src4]
- 2024-06-30: Afslutning af opgørelsesperioden for indikator 4b og indikator 5 (01.07.2023 - 30.06.2024) (indikator-4b, indikator-5) [^src4]
